_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Draft bills from supplier documents
scenarios.description: Create a draft vendor bill for each supplier document, for a person to check and post.

scenarios.label: Answer questions about bills, change nothing
scenarios.description: Look up suppliers and draft bills when someone asks; create and change nothing.

scenarios.label: Drafts with the supplier's document attached
scenarios.description: Create draft bills and attach each supplier's document to its bill, so the person checking has it in one place.

scenarios.label: Ask suppliers for missing details
scenarios.description: Draft bills, and when a document is missing a reference or a tax number, write to the supplier from the bill.

scenarios.label: Remind suppliers later
scenarios.description: Schedule a reminder to a supplier on a draft that is still waiting for their details a week on.

scenarios.label: Pay the bills a person approved
scenarios.description: Draft bills, and once a person has posted one, register its payment.
